[[File:Spacebattle.jpg|thumb|right|350px|The ships of the Open Circle Armada [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|engage]] the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Separatist Fleet]] above [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].]]
The '''Fifth Fleet of the Open Circle Fleet''' was one of the smaller [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Sector fleet/Legends|sector fleets]] that operated under the banner of the [[Open Circle Fleet/Legends|Open Circle Fleet]]. In the closing days of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a vanguard of the Fifth Fleet raced home from the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] to defend [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists']] surprise attack.

In addition to sporting the familiar emblem of the armada, the [[Warship/Legends|warships]] of the Fifth Fleet were identified by five red stripes running down the dorsal wings.

It is not clear if this was the same [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Fifth Fleet (Ai-Ari Kuldi)|Fifth Fleet]], commanded by [[Ai-Ari Kuldi]], that had previously operated in the area of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
